steps.message: What events do I have the Friday after next in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiple titles, format your answer as a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i calendar"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i calendar""
